admin_event_duplicate_body: The copy gets the same details, agenda and organizers, without registrations. It starts as a draft.
admin_registrants_add_title: Add a person to the event
admin_registrants_add_body: The person needs an account. If the event is full, they join the waitlist. They get an e-mail.
admin_registrants_remove_body: The registration is removed and the first person on the waitlist gets the place.
event_message_footer: A message from the organizer of {event}. Reply to this e-mail to write to the organizer.
admin_message_body_hint: Replies go to your e-mail address.

error_ticket_waitlisted: This person is on the waitlist and has no place.

admin_scan_camera_denied: No camera access. Allow the camera in the browser settings and reload the page.
admin_field_room_hint: E.g. B105. Enough instead of a place from the list.
publish_checklist_place_hint: Type a room or pick a place from the list.
publish_checklist_link_invalid: The link must start with https://
publish_checklist_ready: All set. Once published, participants can see the event.
privacy_notice_short: By registering, you share your name and e-mail with the organizer. Registration data, attendance included, is deleted automatically after the retention period.
privacy_who: The university running this service controls the data. The event's organizers can see registration data.
privacy_what: We process your name, e-mail address, registrations for events and agenda items, and attendance to organize the event and send messages about it.
privacy_retention: Registration data, attendance and groups included, is deleted automatically {days} days after the event ends. Account data (name, e-mail) is kept until you delete your account.
privacy_rights: You may access, correct, delete and move your data: on your account page you can download it or delete your account. You may also complain to the Polish data protection authority (UODO).
account_data_body: You can download everything we keep about you, or delete your account with its registrations.
account_data_delete_body: We'll withdraw you from upcoming events (waitlisted people get the places), close your groups and delete the account. This can't be undone.
reg_email_reminder_intro: A reminder: {event} starts {date}. See you there!
event_change_intro: The details of {event}, which you registered for, have changed.
calendar_my_body: Add this address in your calendar (Google, Apple, Outlook) and your registrations show up there on their own.
calendar_my_private: This address is private: don't share it.
error_sole_organizer: You're the only organizer of an upcoming event. Add a co-organizer or cancel the event before deleting your account.
error_last_admin: This is the last admin account. Make someone else an admin before deleting it.
privacy_basis: The basis is your registration for the event, the service you ask for (GDPR art. 6(1)(b)).
error_reauth_required: For your security, sign in again, then delete your account.
event_details_requires_approval: The organiser approves registrations — you will get an e-mail with the decision.
error_approval_required: You can sign up for programme items once the organiser approves your registration.
reg_email_pending_intro: We received your request for {event} ({date}). The organiser will review it — we will write when they decide.
reg_email_rejected_intro: The organiser did not approve your request for {event} ({date}).
admin_field_requires_approval_hint: Requests wait until you approve or decline them.
events_request_success: Request sent — waiting for the organiser's approval
admin_bulk_reject_body: Each person gets an e-mail saying so. You can still approve them later.
admin_visibility_private_hint: Not on the list or in calendars. People with the invite link, registrants and organisers can open it.
admin_invite_regenerate_body: The old link stops working. People already registered still see the event.
admin_invite_description: Each person gets an e-mail with the event link and a sign-up button. Replies come to you.
admin_invite_emails_hint: One address per line or comma-separated, at most {max}.

certificate_intro: We confirm attendance at the event:

questions_options_hint: One per line, at least two.
error_question_options: A choice question needs at least two different answers.
